blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: RGB-based category-level 9D pose estimation remains highly challenging because a monocular system must generalize across unseen object instances while jointly inferring 3D translation, 3D rotation, and 3D size. Unlike instance-level pose estimation, the category-level setting requires the network to learn both what is shared across objects within a category and how individual instances vary in structure. This challenge is amplified in the RGB-only setting, where pose cues, category-level commonality, and instance-specific variation are entangled in appearance without direct geometric constraints, making it difficult for existing frameworks to learn a representation that is truly aligned with the category-level estimation objective. To address this problem, we propose SchemaPose, a schema-guided framework for RGB-based category-level pose estimation. SchemaPose equips the estimation pipeline with an explicit parametric schema for modeling category-level regularities together with structured instance variation, and uses the inferred schema variables to guide pose-related prediction in an end-to-end query-based framework. The same formulation also supports template instantiation, synthetic annotation, and pose learning within a unified framework. Experiments on synthetic and real data show that SchemaPose achieves state-of-the-art performance among RGB-based methods for category-level 9D pose estimation.
blocks.zh: 基于 RGB 的类别级别 9D 的估算仍然极具挑战性,因为一个单光学系统必须泛指整个未见的对象实例,同时共同推断出3D翻译,3D旋转,和3D大小. 与实例级的平面估计不同,类别级设置要求网络既了解一个类别内对象之间共享的内容,又了解单个实例在结构上的差异. 这一挑战在只使用RGB的设定中被放大了,在这种设定中,姿势提示,类别层次的共性,以及具体实例的变异在外观上缠绕而无直接的几何限制,使得现有框架难以学习一种与类别层次估计目标真正一致的表示. 为了解决这个问题,我们提议施克马波斯(SchemaPose),一个基于RGB的类别级的有计划制导框架提出估计. 司马 Pose为估算管道配备了用于模拟类别级常态的明确的参数化方案以及结构化实例变异,并使用推断出的方案变量在一个端到端的查询框架中指导与姿势有关的预测. 同一配方还支持模板即时化,合成注释,并呈现出统一框架内的学习. 关于合成和真实数据的实验表明,SchemaPose在基于RGB的9D级方法中实现了最先进的性能,提出了估计.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Object pose estimation is a fundamental problem in computer vision, with broad applications in robotic manipulation [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 ] , augmented reality [ 5 , 6 , 7 ] , and embodied perception [ 8 , 9 , 10 ] . Compared with instance-level pose estimation, category-level pose estimation aims to recover the poses of previously unseen object instances within a predefined category, making it both more practical for real-world deployment and substantially more challenging [ 11 ] . This challenge becomes especially pronounced in the RGB-only setting, where a monocular system must jointly infer 3D rotation, 3D translation, and 3D size from a single image alone, despite large structural variation across object instances within the same category [ 12 , 13 , 14 ] .
blocks.zh: 物体平面估计是计算机视觉中的一个基本问题,在机器人操纵[1,2,3,4]中广泛应用,增强现实[5,6,7],并体现认知[8,9,10]. 与实例层面的估算相比,类别层面的估算旨在在预先界定的类别中恢复先前未见物体的外观,使之对现实世界的部署更为实际,而且具有更大的挑战性[11]。 这个挑战在只使用RGB的设定中变得特别显著,一个单光子系统必须从一个单一图像中联合推断出3D旋转,3D翻译和3D大小,尽管在同一类中对象的大小结构差异很大[12,13,14].

blocks.en: A key difficulty of category-level pose estimation is that the network must learn not only pose, but also the category-level structure shared across instances and the ways in which individual objects deviate from it [ 12 , 15 ] . This requirement is especially demanding for RGB-based methods, because without direct geometric constraints from depth, pose cues are tightly entangled with instance-specific shape, part configuration, and object extent in monocular RGB observations [ 13 , 16 ] . Consequently, structural differences across instances can affect the interpretation of 3D size and spatial layout, and further complicate rotation and translation estimation, making it difficult for existing frameworks to learn an internal representation aligned with the category-level pose objective.
blocks.zh: 类别级形成估计的一个主要困难是,网络不仅必须了解各种实例之间共有的类别级结构以及单个对象偏离这种结构的方式[12、15]。 这个要求对于基于RGB的方法来说特别苛刻,因为如果没有从深度直接受几何限制,姿势提示会紧紧地缠绕着特异性形状,部分配置,以及单光RGB观测中的对象范围[13,16]. 因此,各种情况之间的结构差异会影响到对三维尺寸和空间布局的解释,并使轮换和翻译估计进一步复杂化,使现有框架难以了解与类别级别相一致的内部表述构成目标。

blocks.en:
A representative line of RGB-based methods [ 17 , 18 , 16 ] builds on NOCS maps [ 11 ] , which provide a shared canonical coordinate space for different instances of the same category.
Pose is then recovered from the predicted 2D–3D or 3D–3D correspondences using geometric solvers [ 19 , 20 ] .
However, recent studies [ 12 , 15 ] show that NOCS maps can be suboptimal for category-level direct prediction, since different object instances may produce different NOCS maps under similar category-level poses, making the mapping from canonical coordinates to pose unnecessarily complex. Moreover, the predicted coordinates often retain substantial instance-specific geometric detail that is not directly aligned with stable pose prediction.
Recent methods [ 21 , 22 ] therefore move toward more direct end-to-end prediction and avoid explicit canonical maps. However, without an explicit structural variable, pose-relevant category structure and instance variation are typically absorbed implicitly into latent or query features, making them hard to supervise, control, or consistently use across the estimation process.
blocks.zh:
基于RGB的方法[17,18,16]的代表性行以NOCS地图[11]为基础,为同一类的不同实例提供共享的舟形坐标空间.
然后用几何解析器从预测的2D–3D或3D–3D通信中取回Pose [19, 20].
然而,最近的研究[12,15]显示,NOCS地图对于分类级直接预测可能不尽人意,因为不同的物体实例可能在相似的分类级外形下产生不同的NOCS地图,使得从犬形坐标来绘制地图会不必要地造成复杂. 此外,所预测的坐标往往保留大量具体实例的几何细节,这些细节与稳定的姿势预测不直接一致。
因此,最近的方法[21,22]转向更直接地进行端到端的预测并避免清晰的舟行图. 然而,如果没有明确的结构变量,与姿势相关的类别结构和实例变化通常被隐含地吸收到潜在或查询特征中,使其难以监督、控制或在整个估算过程中一致使用。

blocks.en: This observation suggests that RGB-based category-level pose estimation requires an explicit structural variable that can capture both category-level regularity and instance-level deviation, and can be used directly throughout the estimation process. In cognitive science [ 23 , 24 , 25 ] , such structured abstractions are often described as schemas: internal organizational models that preserve what is stable across a category while accommodating lawful variation across instances. Rather than focusing on the surface details of individual objects, a schema captures the shared structure of a category together with the factors along which instances differ.
blocks.zh: 这一观点认为,基于RGB的类别级的平面估计需要一个明确的结构变量,既可以捕捉类别级的规律性,也可以捕捉实例级的偏差,可以直接地在整个估计过程中使用. 在认知科学[23、24、25]中,这种结构化抽象往往被描述为计划:内部组织模式,既能保护某一类别中稳定的东西,又能顾及不同情况的合法差异。 一种计划不是侧重于单个物体的表面细节,而是将某一类的共同结构与各种情况不同的因素结合起来。

blocks.en: Motivated by this, we propose SchemaPose, a structure-aware framework for RGB-based category-level 9D pose estimation. SchemaPose introduces a parametric category schema as an explicit structural layer in a unified query-based pipeline, allowing category-level regularity and instance-level variation to be modeled and used directly for pose prediction. We develop a dual-stage schema-guided mechanism so that inferred schema participates in both proposal-stage coarse pose prediction and decoder-stage pose refinement, making structural information available throughout the estimation process rather than only as an auxiliary target. Beyond pose prediction, the same parametric formulation supports template instantiation and synthetic data generation, providing structurally consistent supervision for training.
blocks.zh: 以此为动机,我们提议SchemaPose,一个基于RGB的类别9D的结构认识框架提出估算. 司马 Pose引入了参数类子图,作为统一基于查询的管道中一个明确的结构层,使得类别级的规律性和实例级的变异被模型化并直接用于外观预测. 我们开发出一种双相系统制导机制,以便推断出的系统参与建议阶段的粗度预测和去编码阶段的完善,使结构信息在整个估计过程中都能提供,而不仅仅是作为辅助目标。 除了提出预测外,同样的参数化配方支持模板即时化和合成数据生成,为培训提供结构上一致的监督.

blocks.en: We evaluate SchemaPose on CAMERA25 and REAL275, covering both synthetic and real-world settings. SchemaPose consistently outperforms existing RGB-based category-level pose estimation methods across all metrics. In particular, compared with the strongest prior RGB-based method, SchemaPose improves the 10 ∘ 10^{\circ} 10cm metric from 38.7 to 43.1 on CAMERA25 and from 52.8 to 68.4 on REAL275. Further ablation studies verify that the strong performance of SchemaPose benefits from using meaningful schema information as an explicit structural condition for pose decoding, rather than relying solely on implicit visual features to absorb category-level structural variation.

blocks.en: To summarize, our contributions are as follows. First, we propose SchemaPose, a schema-guided framework for RGB-based category-level 9D pose estimation, enabling the estimation pipeline to better learn category-level commonality and instance variation for pose prediction. Second, we introduce a parametric category schema to explicitly model category-level structure and instance variation, and build a schema-driven data generation pipeline to provide accurate synthetic supervision for SchemaPose training. Third, we develop a dual-stage schema-guided mechanism, where schema inference participates from proposal generation to decoder-level pose prediction, allowing category-level structural information to directly influence the full pose estimation process. Finally, we validate the proposed framework on synthetic and real benchmarks, where SchemaPose surpasses the strongest prior RGB-based method by a large margin, especially on real-world pose accuracy.
blocks.zh: 总之,我们的贡献如下。 首先,我们提议SchemaPose,一个基于RGB的类别级9D的有计划指导框架提出估算,使估算管道能够更好地学习类别级的共性,以及用于预测的变异。 其次,我们引入了一个参数分类方案,以明确模型化类别层次结构和实例变化,并建造一个由计划驱动的数据生成管道,为SchemaPose培训提供准确的合成监督。 第三,我们开发出一种双相分级的分型制导机制,其中分型推论从提案生成到解码层都参与预测,使类级结构信息能直接影响全相位估计过程. 最后,我们验证关于合成和真实基准的拟议框架,其中SchemaPose大大地超越了以往最强的基于RGB的方法,特别是在现实世界方面。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 RGB-Based Category-Level Pose Estimation
blocks.zh: 2.1 基于RGB的类别 -- -- Pose级估计

blocks.en: RGB-based category-level pose estimation aims to recover poses of unseen object instances from monocular images without requiring instance-specific CAD models at inference time. A representative line of work remains geometry-guided. NOCS [ 11 ] establishes a shared canonical space and recovers pose through canonical correspondences, forming the basis of many later RGB-based extensions. MSOS [ 18 ] jointly predicts metric-scale shape and NOCS and renders depth for similarity alignment. OLD-Net [ 17 ] estimates object-level depth together with canonical coordinates and recovers pose through geometric alignment. DMSR [ 16 ] further decouples metric-scale recovery from rigid pose recovery and solves pose from learned correspondences via PnP.

blocks.en: Recent methods increasingly move toward direct regression or more unified prediction. LaPose [ 13 ] performs end-to-end pose regression with uncertainty-aware NOCS modeling, while GIVEPose [ 12 ] argues that instance-specific NOCS maps are suboptimal for direct category-level regression and progressively transforms NOCS toward IVFC. YOPO [ 21 ] formulates category-level 9D pose estimation as DETR-style joint detection and pose prediction from object queries without an explicit alignment stage. LanCOPE [ 26 ] further introduces language-guided multimodal fusion for monocular pose prediction, and Fischer et al. [ 22 ] propose a unified RGB-only framework based on 3D prototypes, dense 2D/3D matching, and multi-model RANSAC PnP. Despite their differences, existing methods either organize pose estimation around canonical geometry and explicit geometric solving, or absorb pose-relevant structural factors implicitly into learned features. Our method instead introduces schema as an explicit structural variable inside the pose estimation framework.
blocks.zh: 最近的方法越来越倾向于直接回归或更统一的预测. LaPose [13] 进行有不确定性意识的NOCS模型化的端到端平面回归,而GivesPose [12]则认为,针对具体实例的NOCS地图对于直接的类别级回归是次优的,并逐渐将NOCS转换为IVFC. YOPO [21] 提出类别级9D的平面估计,作为DETR-风格的联合检测,从对象查询中作出预测,没有明显的对接阶段. LanCOPE [26] 进一步引入了以语言为取向的多式聚变来进行单体外形预测,以及Fischer等人. [22] 提出一个基于3D原型,密集2D/3D相配,以及多型RANSAC PnP的统一RGB-唯一框架. 尽管存在差异,但现有方法要么围绕犬类几何学和明显的几何解来进行估计,要么将与姿势相关的结构因素隐含地吸收到学到的地物中去。 相反,我们的方法引入了方案,作为布局估计框架中的一个明确的结构变量。

blocks.en: 2.2 Canonical Coordinates and Intermediate Representations
blocks.zh: 2.2 运河坐标和中间代表

blocks.en: Canonical coordinates are a central design choice in category-level pose estimation because they provide a shared reference space for unseen instances. NOCS [ 11 ] is the most influential formulation and serves as the basis for many subsequent methods. Recent studies refine this line from different perspectives. SOCS [ 15 ] improves semantic consistency under large intra-category variation through keypoint-guided non-rigid warping. LaPose [ 13 ] models uncertainty over canonical coordinates under monocular ambiguity. GIVEPose [ 12 ] progressively transforms NOCS toward IVFC for direct regression, and DiffusionNOCS [ 27 ] keeps NOCS as the target while replacing deterministic prediction with diffusion-based estimation under multi-modal inputs.
blocks.zh: Canonical 坐标是类别级别中的一种中心设计选择,它们为未见实例提供了共享的参考空间。 NOCS[11]是最有影响力的表述,并成为许多后期方法的基础. 最近的研究从不同的角度完善了这一行. SOCS [15] 在大型类内变异下,通过按键指向的非刚性扭矩来提高语义一致性. LaPose [13] 单曲模糊度下的舟子座标模型不确定性. 给予[12]逐步将NOCS转变为IVFC,用于直接回归,而分化NOCS[27]则将NOCS作为目标,同时在多模式投入下用以扩散为基础的估计取代决定性预测。

blocks.en: These methods improve pose estimation mainly by redesigning the canonical space, the uncertainty model, or the prediction process of canonical maps. In contrast, our method does not pursue another coordinate-space variant. Instead, it introduces schema-guided structural abstraction as a framework-level conditioning variable, aiming to explicitly represent category-level commonality and instance-level variation in a form that can directly support pose prediction.
blocks.zh: 这些方法的改进主要通过重新设计舟体空间,不确定性模型,或舟体地图的预测过程来提出估计. 相反,我们的方法并没有追求另一个坐标-空间变体。 取而代之的是,它引入了有计划制导的结构抽象作为框架级条件变量,旨在以能够直接支持外形预测的形式明确代表类别级共性和实例级差异.

blocks.en: 3.2 Schema Representation and Schema-Driven Data Generation
blocks.zh: 3.2 Schema代表性和Schema-Driven数据生成

blocks.en: In SchemaPose, the parametric category schema serves two connected roles: it defines an explicit structural variable for category-level pose learning, and it provides the generative specification for constructing synthetic training data with aligned schema and pose annotations.
blocks.zh: 在"SchemaPose"中,参数分类schema服务于两个相通的角色:它定义了一个明确的结构变量,用于类别级的姿势学习,它为构建合成训练数据提供基因规格,并配以相通的schema并作说明.

blocks.en:
We define the schema for category c c as a parameterized abstraction that models object structure using geometric primitives (e.g., cuboids, cylinders, rings) and semantic part templates (e.g., body, handle, lid).
Each object instance is specified by a full schema variable z c = ( d c , x c ) z_{c}=(d_{c},x_{c}) , i.e., the complete discrete-continuous encoding of its structure under the category schema. The discrete variables d c d_{c} select the active part configuration and template choices, while the continuous variables x c x_{c} specify the geometric attributes of the selected templates, such as radius, thickness, height, offset, or curvature.
Formally, the instance is generated by M c = Φ c ​ ( d c , x c ) , M_{c}=\Phi_{c}(d_{c},x_{c}), (1) where Φ c \Phi_{c} is the instantiation function that analytically constructs the object by composing the selected part templates and their geometric relations.
This formulation represents a category as a valid, category-consistent family of object instances rather than a fixed prototype, providing a structural basis for both schema-driven data generation and schema-guided pose learning.
Fig. 1 (a) illustrates an example of the schema abstraction.

As shown in Fig. 1 (b), we distinguish the full schema variable used for object instantiation from the compact schema vector used for network learning. The full schema variable z c = ( d c , x c ) z_{c}=(d_{c},x_{c}) specifies all active part templates and geometric parameters required to analytically construct a valid object instance. For pose estimation, however, directly regressing the full instantiated schema would introduce excessive output dimensionality and template-dependent parameter subsets. We therefore derive, for each category, a compact schema vector 𝐠 c = Ψ c ​ ( z c ) , \mathbf{g}_{c}=\Psi_{c}(z_{c}), (2) where Ψ c ​ ( ⋅ ) \Psi_{c}(\cdot) is a category-specific compression function.
This function retains pose-relevant structural factors, such as object extent, proportions, and coarse part configuration, while removing low-level geometric details used only for exact instantiation. Continuous parameters are further normalized by category-specific reference scales or valid parameter ranges, and inactive optional-part parameters are zero-padded to form a fixed category-wise layout. As a result, 𝐠 c \mathbf{g}_{c} provides a compact, normalized, and stable structural target for pose estimation without requiring the network to predict the full instantiable schema.
More details on schema implementation, including geometric primitive construction, part-template composition, and compact schema compression, are provided in Appendix A .

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 3 , SchemaPose adopts an end-to-end query-based architecture consisting of a backbone, a multi-layer Transformer encoder, a multi-layer Transformer decoder, and a Schema-Guided Pose Head (SGPH). Given an input RGB image, the backbone extracts multi-scale features, which are further enhanced by the Transformer encoder to produce the encoder memory 𝐐 e ​ n ​ c \mathbf{Q}_{enc} . The SGPH is first applied to the encoder memory to produce proposal-level predictions, including object category, bounding box, schema, and pose-related quantities. The top-K proposals are then selected according to their classification scores and used to initialize decoder queries. The Transformer decoder refines these queries through cross-attention with the encoder memory, and the same SGPH is applied to the refined query features 𝐐 d ​ e ​ c \mathbf{Q}_{dec} at each decoder layer to produce decoder-level predictions.

SGPH首先被应用于编码器内存,以产生建议级的预测,包括对象类别,边框,计分,和与姿势相关的量. 后根据分级分数选择出上-K推荐,并用于初始化解码查询. 变形器解码器通过与编码器内存的交叉切入来完善这些查询,同样的SGPH被应用于每个解码器层的精密查询特征Q d c\mathbf\dec}以产生解码器级别的预测.

blocks.en: We refer to this design as a Dual-Stage Schema-Guided Mechanism , where “dual-stage” denotes schema guidance at two internal stages of the same end-to-end network: the proposal-generation stage and the decoder-refinement stage. At the proposal stage, a compact schema vector is inferred from encoder memory and used to guide initial pose prediction, ensuring that even the earliest object representations benefit from explicit structural supervision. At the decoder-refinement stage, schema is re-inferred from progressively refined query features and fed back into the pose head to condition iterative pose refinement. In this way, schema information is involved from coarse hypothesis generation to final pose decoding.
blocks.zh: 我们把这种设计称为双层Schema-Guided机制,其中“双相”表示在同一端到端网络的两个内部阶段:建议生成阶段和解码器-精炼阶段。 在建议阶段,从编码器内存中推断出一个紧凑的化学矢量,并用来指导初步的外形预测,确保即使是最早期的物体表示也从明确的结构监督中受益. 在解码器-精炼阶段,Schema从被逐渐精炼的查询特性被再吸收出并反馈回姿势头部,以条件迭代的姿势精炼. 这样,计划信息从粗糙的假说生成到最终形成解码.

blocks.en: SchemaPose is trained end-to-end with unified supervision on detection, schema, and pose prediction. During training, the predictions of object queries are first matched to ground-truth instances by Hungarian matching under a one-to-one assignment. The matching cost is defined on object category and pose-related geometric quantities, including classification confidence, 2D bounding box, translation, and rotation, so that each positive query is assigned to a unique ground-truth instance while unmatched queries are treated as negatives. blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We conduct experiments on the widely used category-level 9D pose estimation benchmarks CAMERA25 and REAL275 [ 11 ] , following the standard six object categories: bottle , bowl , camera , can , laptop , and mug . CAMERA25 is a synthetic dataset containing 275K training images and 25K evaluation images, covering 1,269 object models from ShapeNetCore [ 34 ] . REAL275 is a real-world dataset consisting of 4.3K training images from 7 scenes and 2.75K test images from 6 scenes, with 6 object models in each category. We evaluate SchemaPose on the standard test splits of CAMERA25 and REAL275.
blocks.zh: 我们对广泛使用的9D类进行实验,提出CAMERA25和REAL275[11]的估计基准,遵循标准的6个对象类别:瓶、碗、相机、罐、笔记本电脑和杯子。 CAMERA25是一个合成数据集,包含275K训练图像和25K评价图像,涵盖来自ShapeNetCore的1,269个对象模型[34]. REAL275是一个现实世界数据集,由7个场景的4.3K训练图像和6个场景的2.75K测试图像组成,每个类别有6个物体模型. 我们在CAMERA25和REAL275的标准测试分数上评价了SchemaPose。

blocks.en: Our training data are organized as a mixture of three sources. First, we use our schema-driven synthetic dataset, denoted as SchemaData , generated by the pipeline introduced in Sec. 3.2 . SchemaData provides scene-level synthetic RGB images with aligned pose labels and schema annotations. Unless otherwise specified, we instantiate 10K objects for each category and render 135K training images in total. Second, we use REAL275 training images with additional schema annotations provided by us, which helps schema-supervised learning transfer to real RGB observations. Third, we include CAMERA25 training images without schema annotations to further strengthen pose learning.
blocks.zh: 我们的培训数据是由三个来源组成的混合体。 首先,我们使用我们由计划驱动的合成数据集, 表示为SchemaData, 由Sec引入的管道生成。 3.2 (英语). 司马 数据提供场景级合成RGB图像,并配有对齐的姿势标签和计划说明. 除非另有说明,否则我们将对每个类别的10K物体进行即时分析,并总共制作135K训练图像。 第二,我们使用REAL275训练图像,加上我们提供的附加计划说明,这有助于计划监督的学习转移到真正的RGB观察. 第三,我们包括CAMERA25培训图像,没有计划说明,以进一步加强姿势学习。

blocks.en: By default, the mixed training set consists of 135K images from SchemaData , 135K randomly sampled images from the CAMERA25 training split, and the 4.3K REAL275 training images repeated 6 times. Schema supervision is applied to SchemaData and REAL275 samples, and is masked out for CAMERA25 samples, while detection and pose supervision are retained for all training sources.
blocks.zh: 默认情况下,混合训练集由来自SchemaData的135K图像,来自CAMERA25训练的135K随机取样图像分出,4.3K REAL275训练图像重复了6次. Schema监督适用于SchemaData和REAL275样品,为CAMERA25样品蒙上面具,同时对所有培训来源保留检测和监督。

blocks.en: Following prior work [ 11 , 16 , 21 ] , we report mean Average Precision (mAP) under 3D IoU thresholds and pose accuracy thresholds. Specifically, we use 3D IoU at 50% and 75%, and the standard pose metrics under the 10 ∘ 10^{\circ} rotation error threshold, the 10 cm translation error threshold, and the combined 10 ∘ 10^{\circ} 10 cm criterion.
blocks.zh: 在先前的工作[11,16,21]之后,我们报告3D IoU阈值下的平均精度(mAP)并构成精度阈值。 具体地说,我们使用 3D IoU 50% 和 75%, 标准在 10 + 10 + Circ} 旋转误差阈值, 10 cm 翻译误差阈值, 以及 10 + 10 + Circ} 的 10 cm 等 标准下设置了度量标准 。

blocks.en: We use Swin-L [ 35 ] as the backbone and initialize the detector from a DINO [ 29 ] model pretrained on COCO. We train the network with AdamW [ 36 ] for 12 epochs on the mixed dataset and apply standard data augmentations, including resizing, color augmentation, random translation, and random flipping. All results are reported using a single model.
blocks.zh: 我们使用Swin-L[35]作为骨干,并初始化了DINO[29]型号在COCO上预先训练的探测器. 我们用亚当W[36]为混合数据集上的12个纪元训练网络,并应用了标准的数据增强,包括再大小,色彩增强,随机翻译,和随机翻转. 所有结果均采用单一模式报告。

blocks.en: 4.2 Comparison with State-of-the-Art
blocks.zh: 4.2 与艺术国家的比较

blocks.en: We compare SchemaPose with previous RGB-based category-level 9D pose estimation methods on CAMERA25 and REAL275. As shown in Table 1 , SchemaPose achieves the best results on all reported metrics across both benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了SchemaPose和以前的基于RGB的类别级9D对CAMERA25和REAL275的估计方法。 如表1所示,SchemaPose在两个基准的所有报告指标上都取得了最佳结果。

blocks.en: On CAMERA25, SchemaPose improves over the strongest prior method YOPO [ 21 ] by 5.8 IoU 50 and 4.4 under the 10 ∘ 10^{\circ} 10cm metric. On REAL275, the gains are more pronounced: SchemaPose improves IoU 50 from 71.6 to 86.3 and 10 ∘ 10^{\circ} 10cm from 52.8 to 68.4, corresponding to relative improvements of 20.5% and 29.5%, respectively. The consistent gains across both synthetic and real benchmarks validate SchemaPose as a strong approach for RGB-based category-level 9D pose estimation.

blocks.en: Qualitative results are shown in Fig. 4 . Compared with YOPO, SchemaPose produces more accurate pose estimates in several challenging cases, especially under difficult viewpoints and cluttered real-world scenes. As highlighted by the light-blue arrows, YOPO often suffers from inaccurate pose prediction or even missed detections for small or heavily occluded instances, while SchemaPose can still localize these objects and estimate poses that better match the ground truth.
blocks.zh: 图4显示了定性结果。 Pose在几个具有挑战性的案件中,特别是在困难的观点和杂乱无章的现实世界中,能产生更准确的姿势估计。 正如浅蓝色箭头所强调,YOPO经常遭受不准确的姿势预测,甚至错过了对小的或被严重占用的事件的检测,而SchemaPose仍然可以将这些物体定位,并作出更能与地面真理相匹配的估计.

blocks.en: We attribute the strong performance to the schema-guidance design of SchemaPose, whose motivation comes from the coupling between pose and object structure. The compact schema vector provides explicit cues about object extent, proportions, part layout, and symmetry, which help the pose head interpret monocular observations under intra-category structural variation. This allows the network to use a structured intermediate representation instead of relying solely on implicit query features for pose decoding, thereby making pose prediction more stable and better aligned with category-level structural variation.
blocks.zh: 我们把强大的性能归结于SchemaPose的图谋指导设计,其动机来自姿势和物体结构的结合. 紧凑的schema向量为对象范围、比例、部分布局和对称性提供了明确的提示,这有助于平面在类内结构变异下解释单面观测。 这使得网络可以使用结构化的中间表示,而不是仅仅依靠隐含的查询特性来进行外形解码,从而使外形预测更加稳定并更好地与类别层次的结构变化相配合.

Table 3 evaluates different ways of using schema.
The w/o Schema variant keeps the same backbone, query architecture, training data, and pose heads as SchemaPose, but removes schema supervision and schema guidance. Supervision-only improves over w/o Schema, showing that schema prediction provides useful structural supervision. However, using schema as explicit structural guidance for pose estimation is more effective: decoder-only guidance brings larger gains on IoU 50 and IoU 75 , indicating that schema is especially helpful during refinement. The dual-stage design achieves the best overall performance, demonstrating that combining proposal-stage and decoder-stage schema guidance provides the most balanced benefit.

blocks.en: Table 3 studies whether the gain comes from the structured schema semantics. The full schema, which combines continuous geometric attributes and discrete structural choices, achieves the best overall performance, showing that the two types of factors provide complementary information. Removing either component consistently degrades results, indicating that both are necessary for capturing complete structural information. We further compare with two semantics-broken variants: shuffled schema , where schema annotations are randomly mismatched with object instances during training, and learned latent , where the schema branch is replaced by a same-dimensional latent vector without schema supervision. Both variants perform worse than the true schema, suggesting that the improvement comes from the meaningful structural information encoded by schema, not merely from additional parameters or conditioning dimensions.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented SchemaPose, a schema-guided framework for RGB-based category-level 9D pose estimation. The core idea is to introduce a parametric category schema as an explicit structural variable that captures category-level commonality and instance-specific variation, and to use the inferred schema to guide pose prediction in a query-based network. To support schema learning, we further constructed a schema-driven data generation pipeline that provides aligned pose and schema annotations. Experiments on CAMERA25 and REAL275 show that SchemaPose achieves state-of-the-art performance among RGB-based methods, and ablation studies verify the effectiveness of dual-stage schema guidance, category-aware schema masking, structured schema representation, and balanced mixed training. These results suggest that explicit structural modeling is a promising direction for reducing monocular ambiguity and improving category-level pose estimation under large intra-category variation.

blocks.en: Appendix A Implementation of Parametric Category Schema
blocks.zh: 附录A 参数类别Schema的实施情况

blocks.en:
A parametric category schema consists of three components:
(1) a primitive library,
(2) semantic part templates, and
(3) category-level schema composition.
The primitive library defines basic geometries such as Cuboid , Cylinder , and Ring .
Semantic part templates instantiate and assemble these primitives according to continuous geometric parameters.
Category-level schema composition selects active part templates according to discrete variables and assembles them into a complete object model.
In addition, a compression function maps the full schema variable to the compact schema vector used for network learning.
blocks.zh:
参数类计划包括三个部分:
(1) 原始图书馆,
(2) 语义部分模板,以及
(3)类别级计划构成.
原始图书馆定义了Cuboid、Cylinder和Ring等基本地理学。
语义部分模板即时化并按连续几何参数来组装这些原始人.
Category-level schema 组分根据离散变量选择活性部分模板并组装成完整的对象模型.
此外,一个压缩函数将完整的schema变量映射到用于网络学习的紧凑schema向量.

We first show an example implementation of a basic geometry primitive.
Each primitive is instantiated from a standard canonical template and then deformed by size parameters and transformed by local pose parameters.

class Cuboid():
    def __init__(self, size, position=[0,0,0], rotation=[0,0,0]):
        # Register parameters
        self.length = size[0]
        self.width  = size[1]
        self.height = size[2]
        self.position = position
        self.rotation = rotation

        # Standard cuboid template centered at origin
        self.vertices, self.faces = unit_cuboid()

        # Shape deformation
        self.vertices = self.vertices * [self.length,
                                         self.width,
                                         self.height]

        # Local pose transformation
        self.vertices = apply_pose(self.vertices,
                                   position=self.position,
                                   rotation=self.rotation)

A semantic part template composes one or more primitives and defines their relative geometry.
For example, a cylindrical mug body is instantiated from a ring-like wall and a bottom cylinder, while a trifold handle is instantiated from three cuboids.
The input parameters determine both primitive dimensions and their relative placements.

def compress_mug_schema(d_c, x_c, ref_scale, valid_ranges):
    compact = []

    # Encode discrete template choices
    compact += one_hot(d_c["body_type"],
                       ["cylindrical", "prismatic", "multilevel"])
    compact += one_hot(d_c["handle_type"],
                       ["curved", "trifold", "none"])

    # Select and normalize pose-relevant body parameters
    body_type = d_c["body_type"]
    body = x_c["body"][body_type]
    compact += normalize([
        body["height"],
        body["outer_extent"],
        body["inner_extent"],
        body["thickness"]
    ], ref_scale, valid_ranges["body"])

    # Select and normalize pose-relevant handle parameters
    handle_type = d_c["handle_type"]
    if handle_type != "none":
        handle = x_c["handle"][handle_type]
        compact += normalize([
            handle["extent"],
            handle["offset"],
            handle["thickness"],
            handle["shape_ratio"]
        ], ref_scale, valid_ranges["handle"])
    else:
        compact += zeros(NUM_HANDLE_COMPACT_DIMS)

    return compact

blocks.en: Appendix B Details of Schema-Driven Data Generation
blocks.zh: 附录B Schema-Driven数据生成的细节

blocks.en:
This section details how we construct SchemaData. The pipeline has two stages:
(1) procedural object generation from parametric category schemas, and
(2) compositional scene rendering with BlenderProc [ 30 ] .
blocks.zh:
本节详细介绍了我们如何构建SchemaData. 管道分为两个阶段:
(1) 由参数类计划生成程序对象,以及
(2)配有"BlenderProc"的构成场景渲染 [30].

blocks.en: B.1 Procedural Object Generation
blocks.zh: B.1 程序对象生成

blocks.en: For each category c c , we generate object instances from the full schema variable z c = ( d c , x c ) , z_{c}=(d_{c},x_{c}), where d c d_{c} specifies the discrete template choices and x c x_{c} specifies the continuous geometric parameters. Given z c z_{c} , the instantiation function Φ c \Phi_{c} constructs an object mesh M c = Φ c ​ ( d c , x c ) . M_{c}=\Phi_{c}(d_{c},x_{c}). During generation, we save both the full schema variable z c z_{c} for reproducibility and the compact schema vector 𝐠 c = Ψ c ​ ( z c ) \mathbf{g}_{c}=\Psi_{c}(z_{c}) as the schema annotation used for network supervision.

blocks.en: We first sample the discrete variables d c d_{c} from the valid template choices of each category. These variables determine which semantic part templates are instantiated. For example, in the mug category, we sample the body type from cylindrical, prismatic, or multilevel templates, and sample the handle type from curved, trifold, or none. Similar optional or alternative templates are used for other categories, such as the lid of bottles, pull ring of cans, base of bowls, connector of laptops, and accessory parts of cameras. If a template is set to none , the corresponding part is not instantiated and its compact schema slots are zero-padded.
blocks.zh: 我们首先从每个类别的有效模板选择中取出离散变量d c d_{c}。 这些变量决定了哪些语义部分模板是即时的. 例如,在杯子类中,我们从圆柱形,棱镜形,或多层模板中取出身体型号,从曲线,三相或无相上取出手柄型. 类似的可选或可替代的模板用于其他类别,如瓶盖,取出罐头的拉环,碗底,笔记本电脑的连接器,相机的附属部件等. 如果模板设置为无 ,则相应的部分不会被即时化,其紧凑的 schema 槽是零加法.

blocks.en: After the active templates are selected, we sample their continuous parameters from category-specific valid intervals. These parameters control object dimensions, proportions, thicknesses, offsets, rotations, and part attachment geometry. For a parameter x j x_{j} , we sample x j ∼ 𝒰 ⁡ ( l j , u j ) , x_{j}\sim\mathcal{U}(l_{j},u_{j}), where l j l_{j} and u j u_{j} are defined in the schema configuration. Some bounds are conditional on other sampled parameters. For example, inner radii are constrained to be smaller than outer radii, wall thickness is constrained by the corresponding body extent, and optional-part offsets are constrained to keep the part attached to the supporting body.

blocks.en: To increase intra-category diversity, we vary schema parameters at three levels. First, we vary global object proportions, such as height, width, depth, and overall scale. Second, we vary part-level geometry, such as bottle neck size, bowl opening radius, laptop screen angle, camera lens length, or mug handle size. Third, we vary structural configuration through template choices, such as switching between different body or handle templates. These variations are applied within category-specific constraints so that the generated objects remain valid instances of the target category.
blocks.zh: 为了增加类别内的多样性,我们在三个层次上有不同的计划参数。 首先,我们改变全球物体比例,例如高度、宽度、深度和整体尺度。 第二,我们各有不同的分层几何,如瓶颈大小,碗开半径,笔记本电脑屏幕角度,相机镜头长度,或杯柄大小等. 第三,我们通过模板选择来改变结构配置,例如在不同正文或手柄模板之间切换. 这些变化适用于特定类别的限制,以便生成的物体仍然是目标类别的有效实例。

blocks.en: Each sampled schema variable is checked before export. We reject or resample objects with invalid geometry, including non-positive dimensions, invalid inner–outer relations, excessive thickness, degenerate levels, disconnected optional parts, severe primitive interpenetration, or floating components. This step prevents unrealistic meshes caused by extreme parameter combinations.
blocks.zh: 在导出前将检查每个抽样的计划变量 。 我们拒绝或重新模拟那些具有无效几何特征的物体,包括非正维度、无效的内-外关系、过度厚度、退化水平、断开的可选部分、严重的原始渗透或浮动组件。 这个步骤可以防止极端参数组合造成的不切实际的杂交.

blocks.en: For each valid object, we export the mesh in the category canonical coordinate system. We also save its category label, full schema variable z c z_{c} , compact schema vector 𝐠 c \mathbf{g}_{c} , object scale, and reference scale. The compact vector 𝐠 c \mathbf{g}_{c} is computed by selecting pose-relevant schema factors, normalizing continuous parameters by category-specific reference scales or valid ranges, and zero-padding inactive optional-part slots.
blocks.zh: 对于每个有效的对象,我们导出分类犬类坐标系统中的网格. 我们也保存它的分类标签, 完整的 schema 变量 z c z {c}, 紧凑 schema 矢量 g克\ mathbf{g}_{c}, 对象比例, 和参考比例 。 紧凑的矢量g c\mathbf{g}_{c}是通过选择与姿势相关的计数因素,按特定类别参考尺度或有效范围使连续参数正常化,以及零平铺非活动可选段位来计算的.

blocks.en: B.2 Compositional Scene Rendering
blocks.zh: B.2 组成场景制作

blocks.en: Given the generated object pool, we use BlenderProc to render RGB training images. The goal is to construct cluttered multi-object scenes that expose the network to diverse object poses, layouts, occlusions, and appearance conditions.
blocks.zh: 鉴于生成的对象池,我们使用 BlenderProc 来渲染 RGB 训练图像 。 目标是构筑由多物体组成的复杂场景,使网络暴露于不同的物体外观,布局,被遮住,外观条件.

blocks.en: Each training scene is initialized with a supporting surface, such as a table plane or a floor-like plane, together with a background environment and rendering assets. We randomize the supporting surface geometry and its material appearance so that the rendered scenes do not overfit to a fixed tabletop texture or color. The scene may also contain additional non-target objects or background clutter, depending on the rendering configuration.
blocks.zh: 每个训练场景都以一个支撑平面进行初始化,如平面平面或平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面 我们随机排列支持的地表几何及其物质外观,以便所渲染的场景不会过度地与固定平面纹理或颜色相接. 场景还可能包含额外的非目标对象或背景杂乱,取决于渲染配置.

blocks.en: For each image, we sample a variable number of generated objects from the object pool. The sampled objects may come from different categories, which produces mixed-category scenes. For each sampled object, we load both its mesh and its metadata, including category label, full schema variable, compact schema vector, and canonical size. This ensures that every rendered instance remains associated with its structural annotation throughout the rendering process.
blocks.zh: 对于每个图像,我们从对象池中抽取出一个可变数量的生成对象. 被取样的对象可能来自不同的类别,这些类别会产生混合类场景. 对于每个被采样的对象,我们同时加载其网格和元数据,包括分类标签,完整的计划变量,紧凑的计划向量,和犬科大小. 这可确保每一个已作出的案例在整个渲染过程中都与其结构说明有关。

blocks.en: After object sampling, we place the objects into the scene in a physically plausible manner. Concretely, each object is first assigned a random initial position above the supporting surface and a random initial orientation. We then use BlenderProc’s rigid-body simulation to let the objects settle under gravity until a stable scene configuration is reached. This step automatically resolves many unrealistic placements and produces natural object contacts and occlusions. To avoid degenerate scenes, we reject configurations with severe object interpenetration, unstable placements, or an excessive number of objects falling outside the camera view.
blocks.zh: 在物体取样后,我们把物体放在现场 以物理上可信的方式。 具体来说,每个对象首先被分配到支持面上方的随机初始位置和随机初始方向. 然后我们用 BlenderProc 的僵硬体模拟 让物体在重力下安顿下来 直到到达稳定的场景配置 这一步骤会自动地解决许多不切实际的放置,并产生出天然物体接触和被隔离. 为了避免退化的场景,我们拒绝带有严重物体穿透,位置不稳定,或过多物体掉入相机视图外的配置.

blocks.en: Before or during placement, each object is additionally assigned random scale and pose variation within category-consistent limits. The scale variation is applied to simulate intra-category size diversity, while the 3D rotation and translation are varied to cover a broad pose distribution. Since these transformations are applied to schema-generated objects whose canonical geometry is already known, the final rendered pose labels remain exactly aligned with the instantiated mesh.
blocks.zh: 在放置之前或放置期间,每个物体被额外指定了随机尺度,并在与类别一致的限度内造成变化. 尺度变化适用于模拟类别内大小多样性,而三维旋转和翻译则不同,以涵盖广泛的姿势分布。 由于这些变换被应用到已经知道犬形几何特征的生动物体上,最终制成的姿势标签仍然与即时网完全一致.

blocks.en: To improve robustness to cluttered scenes, we explicitly vary the number of objects, their relative distances, and their degree of overlap. This produces images ranging from isolated-object cases to heavily cluttered scenes with partial occlusion. During rendering, we keep only visible instances whose projected area exceeds a minimum threshold and whose truncation is not excessively large. This avoids adding nearly invisible objects as noisy supervision.
blocks.zh: 为了提高坚固度,以至杂乱无章的场景,我们明确改变物体的数量,它们的相对距离和重叠程度. 这产生了从孤立对象外壳到有部分隐蔽性严重杂乱的场景等各种图像. 在渲染过程中,我们只保留预测面积超过最低阈值且截取量不太大的可见情况。 这避免了增加近乎无形的物体作为吵闹的监督.

blocks.en: We sample the camera pose around the scene by varying azimuth, elevation, and distance relative to the object layout region. The camera is oriented toward the scene center so that most sampled objects remain within view. For each rendered image, the intrinsic matrix K K and the camera extrinsic parameters are recorded. This allows us to export pose labels directly in the camera coordinate system and to train the network under the same monocular RGB setting used at test time.
blocks.zh: 我们用不同方位角、高度和距离来取样 相机在现场布局区域。 相机面向场景中心,这样大多数被采样的物体都留在了视野内. 对于每个制作的图像,都记录了固有的矩阵K K和相机外部参数。 这使得我们能直接在相机坐标系统中导出外形标签,并在测试时使用的同一种单相机RGB设置下训练网络.

blocks.en: To reduce the domain gap between synthetic and real images, we randomize multiple rendering factors independently of the schema parameters. These factors include: • light source type, position, intensity, and color; • material properties such as roughness, metallicness, and specularity; • object colors and surface textures; • background appearance and environment illumination. This decouples structural variation from appearance variation, so that the generated dataset covers both shape diversity and rendering diversity.
blocks.zh: 为了缩小合成图像和真实图像之间的域间隙,我们将多个渲染因子随机化,独立于计划参数. 这些因素包括: • 光源类型,位置,强度,和颜色; • 材料性质,如粗糙度,金属度和光谱; • 物体颜色和表面纹理; • 背景外观和环境发光. 这种与外观变化脱钩的结构变异,使所生成的数据集既能覆盖形状多样性又能渲染多样性.

blocks.en: light source type, position, intensity, and color;
blocks.zh: 光源类型、位置、强度和颜色;

blocks.en: material properties such as roughness, metallicness, and specularity;
blocks.zh: 材料特性,如粗糙度、金属度和分光度;

blocks.en: object colors and surface textures;
blocks.zh: 物体颜色和表面纹理;

blocks.en: background appearance and environment illumination.
blocks.zh: 环境照明。

blocks.en: For each scene, BlenderProc renders an RGB image together with instance-level visibility information. Since the complete scene state is known, we export for every visible target object its category label, 2D bounding box, segmentation mask, 3D rotation, 3D translation, and 3D size. In addition, the compact schema vector 𝐠 c \mathbf{g}_{c} is directly inherited from the object metadata generated in the previous stage. Therefore, the rendered training images provide aligned supervision at both the pose level and the schema level.
blocks.zh: 对于每个场景,BlenderProc会制作一个RGB图像并配以实例级能见度信息. 由于完整的场景状态是已知的,因此我们为每个可见的目标对象导出其分类标签,2D边框,分块掩码,3D旋转,3D翻译,和3D大小. 此外,紧凑的矢量克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克 因此,所制作的培训图像在姿势和计划层面都提供了协调一致的监督。

blocks.en: After rendering, we apply a final filtering step to remove low-quality annotations. Specifically, an object instance is discarded if its visible area is too small, if its projected bounding box is below a minimum size, or if the visible portion is too heavily truncated. This filtering prevents extremely hard or ambiguous synthetic samples from dominating the supervision signal.
blocks.zh: 渲染后,我们应用了最后的过滤步骤来去掉低质量的说明. 具体来说,如果一个对象的可见区域太小,如果它的预测边框低于最小尺寸,或者如果可见部分的截取过重,则被丢弃. 这种过滤可以防止极其硬或模糊的合成样品占据监督信号.

blocks.en: B.3 REAL275 Schema Annotation

In addition to schema annotations generated automatically for SchemaData, we also provide schema annotations for the REAL275 training split to support schema-supervised learning on real RGB images. The annotation is performed only on the REAL275 training objects and does not use any REAL275 test images, test object instances, or test annotations.
blocks.zh: 除了为SchemaData自动生成的计程说明外,我们还为REAL275训练分解提供计程说明,以支持由计程监督的对真实RGB图像的学习. 注释只在REAL275训练对象上进行,不使用任何REAL275测试图像,测试对象实例,或测试说明.

blocks.en: For each REAL275 training object, annotators assign the discrete template choices and continuous schema parameters according to the predefined category schema. The annotation follows the same schema definitions used for synthetic object generation. Specifically, annotators first select the part templates that best match the object structure, and then adjust the continuous parameters so that the object instantiated from the schema is as close as possible to the corresponding real object model. This process produces a compact schema vector through the same compression function Ψ c \Psi_{c} , which is used as schema supervision during training.
blocks.zh: 对于每个REAL275训练对象,注释者根据预定义的类别计划来指定离散模板选择和连续的计划参数. 注释遵循的是合成物体生成所用的相同的计划定义。 具体来说,注释者首先选择最能与对象结构相匹配的部分模板,然后调整连续参数,使从schema中即时化的物体能尽可能地接近相应的真实对象模型. 这个过程通过相同的压缩函数 \ c\ Psi_{c} 生成一个紧凑的 schema 向量, 用于训练时的 schema 监督 。

blocks.en: REAL275 contains six object categories, with three training object instances per category. In our annotation process, each object takes about 20 minutes on average. Since the annotation is performed at the object-instance level rather than the image level, the resulting schema label can be reused for all training images containing the same object. At inference time, SchemaPose does not require any schema annotation or object model; it predicts the schema vector directly from the input RGB image.
blocks.zh: REAL275包含六个对象类别,每个类别有三个训练对象实例. 在我们的注释过程中,每个物体平均需要约20分钟. 由于注解是在对象的层次而不是图像的层次上进行的,因此由此而来的计划标签可以被再用到包含同一对象的所有训练图像上. 在推论时间,SchemaPose不需要任何schema注释或对象模型;它直接从输入的RGB图像中预测schema向量.

blocks.en: C.1 Network Architecture
blocks.zh: C.1 网络结构

blocks.en: Following the design of DINO [ 29 ] , SchemaPose is implemented with a two-stage query-based detector with box refinement. We use Swin-L [ 35 ] as the backbone and initialize the detector from a DINO model pretrained on COCO. The backbone uses an embedding dimension of 192, depths of [ 2 , 2 , 18 , 2 ] [2,2,18,2] , attention heads of [ 6 , 12 , 24 , 48 ] [6,12,24,48] , a window size of 12, and a drop-path rate of 0.2. Feature maps from four backbone stages with channel dimensions [ 192,384,768 , 1536 ] [192,384,768,1536] are projected by a ChannelMapper neck to 256 channels and expanded to 5 feature levels.
blocks.zh: 根据DINO的设计[29],Schema Pose的执行采用两相查询式探测器,并改进了箱. 我们使用Swin-L[35]作为骨干,从COCO上预先训练的DINO模型中初始化了探测器. 骨干采用嵌入维度为192,深度为[2,2,18,2] [2,2,18,2],注意头为[6,12,24,48] [6,12,24,48],窗口大小为12,滴入率为0.2. 有通道维度的四个主干相 [192,384,768,1536] [192,384,768,1536] 的地物图由一条海峡马珀颈向256道投射并被扩展为5个地物级.

blocks.en: The Transformer encoder and decoder both contain 6 layers. The hidden dimension is 256, the feed-forward dimension is 2048, and the decoder uses 8 attention heads. The sine positional encoding uses 128 positional features. At the proposal stage, encoder-side classification scores and boxes are predicted from encoder output features, and the top-100 proposals are selected by maximum classification score to initialize decoder reference queries. In parallel, SGPH is applied to encoder-side features to produce auxiliary detection, schema, and pose predictions for training. During inference, only the predictions from the last decoder layer are used as final outputs.
blocks.zh: 变形器编码器和解码器都包含有6层. 隐藏维为256个,向导维为2048个,解码器使用8个注意力头. 正弦位置编码使用128个位置特征. 在建议阶段,从编码器输出特性中预测出编码器-侧分类分数和框,并用最高分数选择上-上-上-下-上-下-上-下-上-下-上-下-上-下-上-上-下-上-下-上-上-上-下-上-上-下-上-下-下-上-上-下-下-上-下-下-上-下-下-下-上-上-下-下-上-上-下-下-上-下-上-上-下-上-下-上-上-下-下-上-下-上-上-上-下-上-下-上-上-上-下-上-上-下-上-上-上-上-上-下-下-上-上-上-上-下-下-上-上-下-上--上-上-上-上-下-下-上-下---上-上-上-上-上-上-下/下-下-上-上----上- 同时,SGPH被应用于编码器侧面特征,以产生辅助检测,计程,并提出培训的预测. 在推论期间,只有上一层解码器的预测作为最终产出.

blocks.en: C.2 Schema-Guided Pose Head
blocks.zh: C.2 斯克马-吉德波斯头

blocks.en: The Schema-Guided Pose Head predicts object category, 2D bounding box, compact schema, projected center, depth, rotation, and 3D size. It is applied at both the proposal stage and the decoder stage. The prediction branches are not shared across decoder layers; each prediction layer has its own branch parameters following the standard DINO-style refinement design.
blocks.zh: 斯克玛导师之波 头会预测对象类别,2D边框,紧凑的schema,预测中心,深度,旋转,和3D大小. 它既适用于提议阶段,也适用于解码阶段。 预测分支不跨解码层共享;每个预测层都有自己的分支参数遵循标准的DINO风格的完善设计.

blocks.en: The classification branch is a linear layer from the 256-dimensional object feature to 6 category logits. The 2D box branch is a 2-layer MLP with ReLU activations and predicts a normalized box ( c x , c y , w , h ) (c_{x},c_{y},w,h) . The compact schema branch takes the object feature concatenated with the predicted 2D box as input and predicts a 60-dimensional unified schema vector, consisting of 44 continuous dimensions and 16 discrete dimensions.
blocks.zh: 分类分支是一个从256维对象特征到6个类别日志的线性层. 2D盒分支是一个有ReLU活化的2层MLP并预测一个正态的盒(cx,cy,w,h) (c_{x},c_{y},w,h). 紧凑的schema分支将与所预测的2D盒相配合的对象特征作为输入并预测出由44个连续维和16个离散维组成的60维统一schema向量.

blocks.en: The compact schema vector is organized as category-wise slots. The continuous dimensions for bottle , bowl , camera , can , laptop , and mug are ( 11 , 5 , 6 , 7 , 7 , 8 ) (11,5,6,7,7,8) , respectively. The discrete dimensions are ( 3 , 4 , 2 , 2 , 1 , 4 ) (3,4,2,2,1,4) , respectively. During schema conditioning, we construct a category-specific binary mask from the predicted category and keep only the schema slots corresponding to that category. This masked schema vector is then used as the effective structural condition.
blocks.zh: 紧凑的schema向量按类位排列. 瓶子、碗、相机、手提电脑和相机的连续尺寸分别为(11、5、6、7、7、8) (11、5、6、7、7、8)。 离散尺寸分别为(3,4,2,2,2,1,4) (3,4,2,2,1,4). 在计划修饰过程中,我们从预测的类别中构造出一个特定类别的二进制掩码,并且只保留与该类别对应的计划槽. 这种被遮住的图示向量随后被用作有效的结构条件.

blocks.en: For pose prediction, the projected center, depth, rotation, and size branches are implemented as MLPs with two hidden layers. The predicted 2D box and the effective schema vector are concatenated to all four pose branches, serving as spatial and structural guidance, respectively. Therefore, all pose-related branches take a 320-dimensional input, formed by concatenating the 256-dimensional object feature, 4-dimensional 2D box, and 60-dimensional effective schema vector. Rotation is represented by the continuous 6D representation [ 38 ] . We use class-wise rotation and size heads: the rotation branch outputs 6 × 6 = 36 6\times 6=36 values, and the size branch outputs 6 × 3 = 18 6\times 3=18 values. During inference, the rotation and size corresponding to the predicted category are selected.
blocks.zh: 为作姿势预测,所预测的中心,深度,旋转和大小分支作为有两层隐藏的MLP被执行. 所预测的2D盒和有效schema向量被调和到所有四个平面分支,分别作为空间和结构取向. 因此,所有与姿势相關的分会都取取出320维的输入,由256维的物体特征,4维的2D盒和60维有效的schema向量相接而成. 旋转由持续的6D代表[38]代表. 我们使用分级旋转和大小头:旋转分支输出 6×6 = 36 6\times 6=36等值,而大小分支输出 6×3 = 18 6\times 3=18等值. 在推论期间,选择了与预测类别相适应的旋转和大小.

blocks.en: C.3 Loss Weights and Matching Costs
blocks.zh: C.3 重量和相配费用

blocks.en: SchemaPose is trained with detection, pose, and schema losses. For detection, we use focal loss for classification, ℓ 1 \ell_{1} loss for 2D box regression, and GIoU loss for box overlap. For pose prediction, we use ℓ 1 \ell_{1} loss for the projected center, ℓ 2 \ell_{2} loss for depth, geodesic rotation loss for rotation, and ℓ 2 \ell_{2} loss for 3D size. For schema prediction, we use ℓ 1 \ell_{1} loss for continuous schema dimensions and sigmoid cross-entropy loss for discrete schema dimensions. Schema losses are applied only when schema annotations are available; otherwise, the schema loss weights are masked out for that sample.

blocks.en: C.4 Training Hyperparameters
blocks.zh: C.4 训练超参数

blocks.en: We train SchemaPose on 4 NVIDIA H200 GPUs with a per-GPU batch size of 8, resulting in a total batch size of 32. We use AdamW with a base learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} and enable automatic learning-rate scaling with a reference batch size of 16. Therefore, the effective learning rate is scaled to 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} . The weight decay is 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} , and the backbone learning rate is multiplied by 0.1. We apply gradient clipping with a maximum norm of 0.1.

blocks.en: Appendix D Discussion on Parametric Category Schema
blocks.zh: 附录D 关于参数类别Schema的讨论

blocks.en: The parametric category schema provides an explicit structural context for category-level pose estimation. In the RGB-only setting, the same image evidence may correspond to different 3D interpretations because object extent, proportions, part layout, and symmetry vary across instances within the same category. Schema makes these factors explicit. Continuous schema parameters describe metric-relevant properties such as object size, aspect ratio, thickness, and part offsets, which help the network reason about 3D scale and translation under monocular ambiguity. Discrete schema variables describe structural choices such as part existence, template type, and coarse configuration, which provide cues for resolving orientation ambiguity caused by symmetry or anisotropic object layouts.
blocks.zh: 参数分类方案为类别水平的平面估计提供了明确的结构上下文。 在只使用RGB的设定中,相同的图像证据可能对应不同的3D解释,因为对象范围,比例,部分布局,以及同一类内的情况的对称性不同. Schema明确了这些因素。 连续的schema参数描述了对象大小,外观比,厚度等与度量相关的属性,以及部分相抵,这有助于网络对3D尺度的理性和单向模糊的翻译. discrete schema变量描述了部分存在,模板类型等结构选择,以及粗糙的配置,为解决由对称或同位素对象布局引起的方向模糊提供提示.

blocks.en: This structural information complements visual query features. Without schema, the network must encode category-level commonality, instance-specific shape variation, and pose cues in the same latent representation. This can make pose prediction sensitive to irrelevant appearance details or instance-specific geometry. By contrast, schema separates pose-relevant structure into an explicit intermediate variable. The pose head can then condition its prediction on both visual evidence and structured object information, making rotation, translation, and size estimation more aligned with the category-level 9D pose objective.
blocks.zh: 这种结构信息补充了视觉查询功能. 没有计划,网络必须编码类别层次的共性,具体实例的形状变化,并在相同的潜在代表中提出提示。 这可以使预测对无关的外观细节或特异性几何具有敏感性. 相形之下,Schema将与外形相关的结构分离为一个明显的中间变量. 姿势头随后可以以视觉证据和结构化对象信息作为预测条件,使旋转,翻译,大小估计与9D类更相符合,从而形成目标.

blocks.en: Importantly, schema is not a fixed prototype or a substitute for visual learning. It represents a parameterized family of valid category instances, while the network still learns to infer schema and pose from RGB observations. Its role is to organize the structural variation that affects pose prediction, so that the estimator does not need to recover all such factors only through unconstrained latent features.
blocks.zh: 重要的是,计划不是固定的原型,也不是视觉学习的替代. 它代表了有效类例的参数化家族,而网络仍然学会从RGB观察中推断出计划并出场. 其作用是组织影响外形预测的结构变异,这样估计器就不需要只通过不受约束的潜在特征来回收所有这些因素.

blocks.en:
Parametric Category Schema can comprehensively describe the structural information of various objects encountered in daily life. This expressive power of schema comes from the composition of reusable geometric primitives and semantic part templates. Basic primitives, such as cuboids, cylinders, rings, and other simple parameterized shapes, describe common local geometry, while semantic templates organize these primitives into meaningful object parts. This design follows the observation that many man-made objects can be described as combinations of basic geometric components, where each primitive captures a family of shapes through its parameters and their composition yields diverse object structures [ 23 , 25 ] .
As a reference, PartNet-Mobility [ 9 ] is a large-scale articulated object dataset collected from real-world manufacturer-level 3D models, covering substantial intra-category structural variation. For the six pose-estimation categories considered in this work, our parametric category schemas can represent nearly all corresponding instances from Xiang et al. [9] by composing the predefined primitives and part templates with category-specific parameter ranges. This coverage suggests that the proposed schema representation is expressive enough to capture the major structural variations required for category-level pose estimation, while remaining compact and analytically controllable.
blocks.zh:
参数类Schema可以全面描述日常生活中遇到的各种物体的结构信息. 这种表征力从可再用几何原始和语义部分模板的构成而来. 基本原始物,如立方体,圆柱体,环等简单的参数化形状,描述出常见的局部几何,而语义模板则将这些原始物组织成有意义的物体部分. 这种设计遵循了一种观点,即许多人造物体可以被描述为基本几何元件的组合,即每个原始人通过它的参数捕捉出一系形状,而其组成产生出不同的物体结构[23,25].
作为参考,PartNet-Mobility [9]是一个从现实世界制造商级3D模型中收集的大型的明快对象数据集,涵盖大量类别内结构变异. 对于本作中考虑的六个平面估计类别,我们的参数分类方案几乎可以代表Xiang等人的所有相应情况。 [9] 通过将预定义的原始和部分模板与特定类别参数范围组合起来. 这一覆盖面表明,拟议的方案说明足以反映类别级别估计所需的重大结构变化,同时保持紧凑和可分析控制。

blocks.en: As mentioned above, the strong expressiveness of reusable geometric primitives and semantic part templates enables parametric schema to easily scale to novel object categories. Extending SchemaPose to a new category usually starts by identifying reusable components from the existing part templates, and then specifying category-specific composition rules and parameter ranges. For example, handle-like templates can be reused for mugs, drawers, or containers, while cylindrical body templates can support many container-like categories with different proportions and attachment rules. If the existing library is insufficient, a new template can be implemented by inheriting from existing part templates and invoking basic geometry templates. In our implementation, developing parametric schema for a novel category takes about 2 hours on average. Once implemented, the new templates are added back to the schema library and can be reused by later categories, making the construction process cumulative and increasingly efficient as the library grows, rather than a from-scratch design process for every category.
blocks.zh: 如上所述,可再利用的几何原始和语义部分模板的强烈表达力使得参数化的生平图可以轻松地被缩放到新颖的对象类别. 扩展Schema Pose to a new speak 通常首先从现有的部分模板中识别可重复使用的组件,然后指定特定类别的构成规则和参数范围. 例如,类似手柄的模板可以被再用到杯子,抽屉,或容器上,而圆柱体模板可以支持许多不同比例和附加规则的类似容器的类别. 如果现有的库不够,可以通过继承现有的部分模板并引用基本的几何模板来实施新的模板. 在我们的实施中,为一个新类别制定参数化计划平均需要大约2小时。 一旦实施,新的模板会被重新添加到schema库中,并且可以被后期分类重用,使构建过程随着库的成长而累积并越来越有效率,而不是为每个类别设计出一个从抽取来的设计过程.

blocks.en: The same schema formulation is used both for object generation and for network learning. During data generation, the full schema variable specifies template choices, geometric parameters, and analytic relations needed to instantiate valid object meshes. During learning, a compact schema vector derived from the full schema variable provides pose-relevant structural supervision. This consistency is important: the structural variables used to generate synthetic object instances are the same variables that the network learns to infer and use for pose prediction. As a result, schema provides not only a generative specification for constructing diverse training data, but also an explicit intermediate representation that connects image observations with category-level pose estimation.
blocks.zh: 同一计划配方用于物体生成和网络学习. 在数据生成过程中,完整的schema变量指定了模板选择,几何参数,以及即时化有效对象 meshes所需的分析关系. 在学习过程中,从全分型变量中衍生出的一种紧凑的分型向量提供了与外形相关的结构监督. 这种一致性很重要:用来生成合成对象实例的结构变量是网络所学会的推断和用于外形预测的等同变量. 因此,Schema不仅为构建多种培训数据提供了基因化的规格,而且还提供了将图像观测与类别层相连接的明确的中间代表.

blocks.en: Appendix E Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 附录E 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: While SchemaPose demonstrates the effectiveness of introducing explicit schema information into RGB-based category-level pose estimation, several directions remain open for future exploration.
blocks.zh: 司马时 Pose证明了将明确的计划信息引入基于 RGB 的类别级估计的有效性,若干方向仍然可供今后探索。

blocks.en: In the current implementation, category schemas are designed manually based on geometric primitives, semantic part templates, and category-level structural analysis. This design makes the resulting schema interpretable and directly usable for both object generation and pose prediction. A promising future direction is to reduce the amount of manual design by developing semi-automatic or data-driven tools for schema construction. For example, candidate primitives, part templates, or parameter ranges could be proposed from collections of 3D models or generated instances, and then refined into compact schema definitions with minimal human intervention.
blocks.zh: 在目前的执行中,类别计划是根据几何原始,语义部分模板,以及类别级结构分析而手工设计的. 这种设计使由此产生的计划可以解释和直接用于物体生成并作出预测。 一个有希望的未来方向是通过开发半自动或由数据驱动的造型工具来减少人工设计的数量. 例如,可以从收集3D模型或生成实例中提出候选原始物、部分模板或参数范围,然后用最低限度的人类干预来细化成紧凑的系统定义。

blocks.en: The current schema library is constructed for the object categories studied in our experiments. Since schemas are built from reusable geometric primitives and semantic part templates, the library can be extended cumulatively as more categories are considered. Future work will expand the collection of primitives, templates, and category-specific composition rules, so that a broader range of object categories can share and reuse existing schema components. Such an expanding library would also make schema construction increasingly efficient, as newly defined templates can benefit later categories.
blocks.zh: 目前的计划库是为我们实验中研究的对象类别而构建的. 由于schemas是用可再使用的几何原始和语义部分模板来构建的,因此随着更多类别的考虑,库可以被累积地扩展. 未来的工作将扩大原始物,模板,和类别特定组成规则的收集范围,使更广泛的对象类别可以共享并再用已存在的schema组件. 这种扩大的图书馆还将使计划构建更加高效,因为新定义的模板可以有利于以后的分类。

blocks.en: The schema-driven data generation pipeline provides accurate schema and pose annotations by construction, but the visual distribution of synthetic data can still differ from real RGB observations. Although mixed training and rendering randomization reduce this gap, future work can further improve synthetic-to-real transfer through stronger domain randomization, more realistic material and lighting simulation, or image-level adaptation. This direction is particularly important for making schema-supervised learning more effective in real-world deployment.
blocks.zh: 由schema驱动的数据生成管提供了准确的schema并按构造提出说明,但合成数据的可视分布仍能与真正的RGB观测不同. 虽然混合培训和使随机化可以缩小这一差距,但今后的工作可以通过更强的域随机化,更现实的材料和照明模拟,或图像级别的适应,来进一步改善合成到真实的转移. 这一方向对于在现实世界部署中使有计划的监督学习更加有效尤为重要。

blocks.en: SchemaPose estimates category-level 9D pose from a single RGB image. In many practical scenarios, however, multiple frames or multiple views are available. Extending schema-guided pose estimation to temporal or multi-view settings could provide additional constraints for resolving ambiguity in monocular observations. Since schema represents stable object structure, it can naturally serve as a consistency variable across frames or views, enabling more robust pose estimation under occlusion, viewpoint change, and clutter.
blocks.zh: 司马 Pose从一个单一的RGB图像中估算出类别级为9D的平面. 但是,在许多实际情景中,有多种框架或多种观点。 将图示制扩展为时间或多视图设置可以为解决单视观测中的模糊性提供额外的限制。 由于 schema 代表了稳定的对象结构,它自然可以作为一个横跨框架或观点的相容变量,使得在被遮蔽,观点变化,和杂乱无章的情况下,能够更稳健地提出估计.

blocks.en: Overall, these directions suggest that schema-guided pose estimation is not limited to the current implementation, but can be further developed through more automatic schema construction, richer schema libraries, improved synthetic-to-real transfer, and stronger temporal or multi-view reasoning.
blocks.zh: 总体来说,这些方向表明,由计划指导的平面估计并不限于目前的实施,而是可以通过更自动地进行计划构建,更丰富的计划库,更好的合成到现实的转移,以及更强大的时间或多视角推理来进一步发展.

However, if there is a direct path to any negative applications, the authors should point it out. For example, it is legitimate to point out that an improvement in the quality of generative models could be used to generate Deepfakes for disinformation. On the other hand, it is not needed to point out that a generic algorithm for optimizing neural networks could enable people to train models that generate Deepfakes faster. • The authors should consider possible harms that could arise when the technology is being used as intended and functioning correctly, harms that could arise when the technology is being used as intended but gives incorrect results, and harms following from (intentional or unintentional) misuse of the technology. • If there are negative societal impacts, the authors could also discuss possible mitigation strategies (e.g., gated release of models, providing defenses in addition to attacks, mechanisms for monitoring misuse, mechanisms to monitor how a system learns from feedback over time, improving the efficiency and accessibility of ML). 11. Safeguards Question: Does the paper describe safeguards that have been put in place for responsible release of data or models that have a high risk for misuse (e.g., pre-trained language models, image generators, or scraped datasets)? Answer: [N/A] . Justification: The paper does not release high-risk models, scraped datasets, or assets requiring special safeguards. Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the paper poses no such risks. • Released models that have a high risk for misuse or dual-use should be released with necessary safeguards to allow for controlled use of the model, for example by requiring that users adhere to usage guidelines or restrictions to access the model or implementing safety filters. • Datasets that have been scraped from the Internet could pose safety risks. The authors should describe how they avoided releasing unsafe images. • We recognize that providing effective safeguards is challenging, and many papers do not require this, but we encourage authors to take this into account and make a best faith effort. 12. Licenses for existing assets Question: Are the creators or original owners of assets (e.g., code, data, models), used in the paper, properly credited and are the license and terms of use explicitly mentioned and properly respected? Answer: [Yes] Justification: The paper cites the existing datasets, tools, and codebases used in the work, including public benchmarks and rendering tools, and follows their intended research use. Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not use existing assets. • The authors should cite the original paper that produced the code package or dataset. • The authors should state which version of the asset is used and, if possible, include a URL. • The name of the license (e.g., CC-BY 4.0) should be included for each asset. • For scraped data from a particular source (e.g., website), the copyright and terms of service of that source should be provided. • If assets are released, the license, copyright information, and terms of use in the package should be provided. For popular datasets, paperswithcode.com/datasets has curated licenses for some datasets. Their licensing guide can help determine the license of a dataset. • For existing datasets that are re-packaged, both the original license and the license of the derived asset (if it has changed) should be provided. • If this information is not available online, the authors are encouraged to reach out to the asset’s creators. 13. New assets Question: Are new assets introduced in the paper well documented and is the documentation provided alongside the assets? Answer: [Yes] Justification: The paper introduces a schema-driven synthetic dataset/pipeline and documents its generation procedure, annotations, and intended research use. The release plan and documentation will be provided with the supplementary material or project page when applicable. Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not release new assets. • Researchers should communicate the details of the dataset/code/model as part of their submissions via structured templates. This includes details about training, license, limitations, etc. • The paper should discuss whether and how consent was obtained from people whose asset is used. • At submission time, remember to anonymize your assets (if applicable). You can either create an anonymized URL or include an anonymized zip file. 14. Crowdsourcing and research with human subjects Question: For crowdsourcing experiments and research with human subjects, does the paper include the full text of instructions given to participants and screenshots, if applicable, as well as details about compensation (if any)? Answer: [N/A] Justification: The paper does not involve crowdsourcing or research with human subjects. Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not involve crowdsourcing nor research with human subjects. • Including this information in the supplemental material is fine, but if the main contribution of the paper involves human subjects, then as much detail as possible should be included in the main paper. • According to the NeurIPS Code of Ethics, workers involved in data collection, curation, or other labor should be paid at least the minimum wage in the country of the data collector. 15. Institutional review board (IRB) approvals or equivalent for research with human subjects Question: Does the paper describe potential risks incurred by study participants, whether such risks were disclosed to the subjects, and whether Institutional Review Board (IRB) approvals (or an equivalent approval/review based on the requirements of your country or institution) were obtained? Answer: [N/A] Justification: The paper does not involve human subjects research, so IRB approval is not applicable. Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not involve crowdsourcing nor research with human subjects. • Depending on the country in which research is conducted, IRB approval (or equivalent) may be required for any human subjects research. If you obtained IRB approval, you should clearly state this in the paper. • We recognize that the procedures for this may vary significantly between institutions and locations, and we expect authors to adhere to the NeurIPS Code of Ethics and the guidelines for their institution. • For initial submissions, do not include any information that would break anonymity (if applicable), such as the institution conducting the review. 16. Declaration of LLM usage Question: Does the paper describe the usage of LLMs if it is an important, original, or non-standard component of the core methods in this research? Note that if the LLM is used only for writing, editing, or formatting purposes and does not impact the core methodology, scientific rigor, or originality of the research, declaration is not required. Answer: [Yes] Justification: LLM usage is declared in the appendix. Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the core method development in this research does not involve LLMs as any important, original, or non-standard components. • Please refer to our LLM policy in the NeurIPS handbook for what should or should not be described.
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 索赔问题: 抽象和导言中的主要主张是否准确地反映了文件的贡献和范围? 答复:[是] 说明: 抽象和入门陈述了SchemaPose的主要贡献,包括: schema-guided框架,参数类 schema, schema-驱动的数据生成,以及经验验证. 这些索赔有方法部分和实验部分作为佐证。 准则: 答案[N/A]是指抽象和导言不包括文件中提出的要求。 抽象和/或导言应明确说明所提出的主张,包括文件中的贡献以及重要的假设和限制。 [否]或[否/A]对这个问题的答复不会为审议者所看好。 所提出的索赔应当与理论和实验结果相匹配,并反映在多大程度上可以期望将结果归纳到其他环境中。 只要文件明确没有实现这些目标,就最好将理想目标作为动力列入。 2. 限制问题: 文件是否讨论了作者所做工作的限制? 答复:[是] 说明: 该文件讨论了计划构建的范围和局限性,包括它依赖参数模板及其适用于其结构变化能够被这种模板合理反映的对象类别。 • 答案[N/A]是指文件没有限制,而答案[否]是指文件有限制,但在文件中没有讨论。 鼓励作者在论文中另设"限制"一栏. 文件应该指出任何强有力的假设,以及这些假设被违反的结果如何有力(例如,独立性假设、无噪声设置、模型精确度、不对称近似只在当地持有)。 作者应思考这些假设在实践中可能如何被违反以及会产生什么影响。 作者应反思所提出主张的范围,例如,如果该办法只在几个数据集或几个运行中测试。 一般来说,经验性结果往往取决于隐含的假设,应当加以阐述。 作者应思考影响该方法执行的因素。 例如,一面相识别算法在图像分辨率低或图像取自于低照明时可能表现不佳. 或语音到文本系统可能无法可靠地用于为在线讲座提供闭门字幕,因为它无法处理技术术语。 作者应讨论拟议算法的计算效率,以及它们如何用数据集大小进行比例。 如果适用,作者应讨论他们处理隐私和公平问题的方法可能存在的局限性。 虽然作者可能担心审查人员会把完全诚实的局限性作为拒绝的理由,但更糟糕的结果可能是审查人员发现文件中没有承认的局限性。 作者应运用最佳判断,并承认有利于透明度的个别行动在制定维护社会完整性的规范方面发挥重要作用。 将特别指示审查人员不要惩罚有关限制的诚实行为。 3. 理论假设和证明 问题: 对于每一项理论结果,论文是否提供了一整套假设和完整的(和正确的)证明? 答复:[不详]理由: 论文不包括理论成果. 指导方针: 答案[N/A]是指论文不包括理论结果. 二. 支助 纸上所有定理,公式和证明,都应该编号并相互参照. 二. 支助 • 所有假设均应在任何定理的说明中明确说明或提及。 证据可以出现在正文或补充材料中,但如果在补充材料中出现,则鼓励作者提供简短的证明草图来提供直觉. • 反之,文件核心中提供的任何非正式证据应辅以附录或补充材料中提供的正式证据。 • 应适当参考证据所依据的定理和莱玛。 4. 实验结果可复制 问题: 文件是否充分披露复制文件主要实验结果所需的所有信息,以影响文件的主要主张和/或结论(无论是否提供代码和数据)? 答复:[是] 说明: 文件介绍了模式架构、方案表述、数据生成管道、培训目标、数据集、评价衡量标准以及复制主要实验结果所需的开发设置。 准则: 答案[N/A]是指该文件不包括实验。 如果论文包括了实验,审查人员将不会很好地看待对这一问题的回答: 使该文件可以复制很重要,无论是否提供代码和数据。 如果资料是数据集和/或模型,作者应说明为使结果可以复制或核实而采取的步骤。 • 视贡献情况,可采用各种方式实现可复制性。 例如,如果这种贡献是一种新颖的架构,充分描述这种架构可能就足够了,或者如果这种贡献是一种具体的模型和经验性评价,那么就可能有必要使其他人有可能用同样的数据集复制该模型,或者提供对模型的取用. 总论. 释放代码和数据往往是实现这一目的的好办法,但也可以通过详细指示来提供可复制性,说明如何复制结果,访问主机模型(如在大语言模型的情况下),释放模型检查点,或者其他适合进行的研究的手段. 二. 支助 虽然NeurIPS并不要求发布代码,但会议确实要求所有提交文件提供一些合理的可复制途径,这可能取决于贡献的性质. 例如(a) 如果贡献主要是一种新的算法,则论文应当说明如何复制该算法。 (b) 如果贡献主要是新的示范架构,文件应清楚而全面地描述该架构。 (c) 如果贡献是一个新的模型(例如大型语言模型),那么应该有一种方法来访问这个模型来复制结果,或者有一种方法来复制模型(例如,有一个开源数据集或关于如何构建数据集的指示). (d) 我们认识到,在某些情况下,可复制性可能很困难,在这种情况下,欢迎作者说明它们为可复制性规定的具体方式。 就闭源模型而言,可能以某种方式(例如,对已注册的用户)限制对模型的访问,但其他研究者应该有一定途径复制或验证结果. 5. 开放存取数据和代码 如补充材料所描述的那样,该文件是否提供了公开查阅数据和代码的机会,并提供了忠实复制主要实验结果的充分指示? 答复: [是] 理由: 我们提供匿名代码,配置文件,数据生成脚本,并指示复制补充材料中的主要实验. 生成的合成数据集因其大小而通过匿名URL提供. · 答案[N/A]是指纸张不包括需要密码的实验。 详情请见NeurIPS代码和数据提交准则(https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy)。 虽然我们鼓励发布代码和数据,但我们理解这也许是不可能的,因此[否]是一个可以接受的答案. 文件不能仅仅因为没有包含代码而被拒绝,除非这是贡献的核心(例如,对于一个新的开源基准). 二. 支助 指示应包含复制结果所需的准确命令和环境。 详情见NeurIPS代码和数据提交准则(https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy)。 作者应提供关于数据存取和准备的说明,包括如何取用原始数据、预处理后的数据、中间数据和生成的数据等。 作者应提供脚本来复制所有实验结果,用于新的拟议方法和基线。 如果只有一组实验可以复制,它们应该说明哪些实验从剧本中删除,以及为什么。 在提交来文时,为了保持匿名,提交人应公布匿名版本(如果适用)。 • 建议在补充材料中提供尽可能多的资料(附于文件),但允许将URL纳入数据和代码。 6. 实验设置/细节问题: 文件是否具体说明了解结果所需的所有培训和测试细节(例如数据分解、超参数、如何选择、优化者类型等)? 答复:[是] 说明: 该文件具体规定了实验中使用的数据集、分块、评价衡量标准、培训协议、损失功能以及实施细节。 准则: 答案[N/A]是指该文件不包括实验。 试验环境应在文件的核心中详细介绍,以便评估结果,使之合理。 详细情况可通过守则、附录或补充材料提供。 7. 实验统计意义 问题: 纸质报告的错误是否包含适当和正确定义的信息或关于实验的统计意义的其他适当信息? 答复:[是] 说明: 我们在附录中报告了REAL275主要实验在5个随机种子上的平均和标准的偏差. 准则: 答案[N/A]是指该文件不包括实验。 如果结果附有出错栏、置信间隔或统计意义测试,至少对于支持论文主要主张的实验,作者应回答[是]。 应明确说明错误条所捕获的可变因素(例如,列车/测试分拆、初始化、随机绘制某些参数,或在特定实验条件下的总体运行)。 计算出错栏的方法应加以解释(封闭表单公式、调用库函数、靴子等) • 应给出假设(例如,通常分布式错误)。 应明确出错栏是标准偏差还是平均值的标准出错. ^ 报告1-西格玛出错栏是好的,但应该说明这一点。 撰文者最好报告2-西格玛出错栏,而不是说如果错误的正常性假设没有得到核实,他们有96%的CI。 二. 支助 对于不对称分布,作者应注意不要在表格或数字对称错误栏中显示会产生超出范围的结果(如负出错率). 二. 支助 如果在表格或图中报告出错栏,作者应在正文中解释其计算方式并参考正文中的相应数字或表格. 8. 实验计算资源 问题:对于每个实验,论文是否提供了复制实验所需的计算机资源(计算工人类型,内存,执行时间)的充分信息? 答复:[是] 说明: 文件报告了用于培训和评价的硬件,包括GPU类型和大约培训时间. 准则: 答案[N/A]是指该文件不包括实验。 纸张应说明计算工人的CPU或GPU、内部集群或云提供商的类型,包括相关的内存和存储。 文件应提供每次试验所需的计算数额并估计总计算数。 文件应披露整个研究项目是否比文件所报道的实验需要更多的计算(例如,初步或失败的实验,这些实验没有把它写入文件)。 9. 道德守则问题:文件中进行的研究是否在各个方面都符合《新IPS道德守则》(https://neurips.cc/public/Ethics Guidelines)? 答复: [是] 理由: 该研究采用标准公共基准和合成数据生成,不涉及人类主体,私人数据,或有害数据的收集. • 答案[N/A]意味着作者没有审查《新IPS道德守则》。 如果作者回答[否],他们应当解释需要偏离道德守则的特殊情况。 提交人应确保匿名(例如,如果由于其管辖范围内的法律或条例而得到特别考虑)。 10. 更广泛的影响问题:本文件是否讨论所开展工作的潜在积极社会影响和负面社会影响? 答复:[是] 说明: 该文件讨论了机器人方面的潜在积极影响和体现的认知,以及可能造成现实世界机器人系统失灵的可能限制。 · 答案[N/A]是指所进行的工作没有社会影响。 如果作者回答[N/A]或[否],他们应解释他们的工作为何没有社会影响,或为何文件不讨论社会影响。 二. 支助 负面社会影响的例子包括潜在的恶意或意外使用(如:造谣、制造假相、监视)、公平考虑(如:采用可能作出对特定群体造成不公平影响的决定的技术)、隐私考虑和安全考虑。 会议期望许多论文将是基础研究,而不是与特定应用挂钩,更不用说部署. 然而,如果有任何否定性申请的直接途径,提交人应当指出。 例如,可以合理地指出,可以利用基因模型质量的提高来产生用于造谣的Deepfakes. 另一方面,不需要指出优化神经网络的通用算法可以使人们能训练出能更快地生成Deepfake的模型. ^ 作者应考虑在技术被作为预期和正确使用时可能产生的伤害,在技术被作为预期使用时可能产生的伤害,但产生不正确的结果,以及因(有意或无意)滥用技术而可能造成的损害。 如果存在负面的社会影响,作者还可以讨论可能的缓解战略(例如,对模型进行严格公布,在攻击之外提供防御,监测滥用的机制,监测系统如何从反馈中学习的机制,提高ML的效率和可获取性)。 11. 保障问题: 文件是否描述了为负责任地发布滥用风险高的数据或模型(如预先培训的语言模型、图像生成器或被刮去的数据集)而采取的保障措施? 答:[无. 说明: 该文件不发布高风险模型、已报废的数据集或需要特别保障的资产。 准则: 答案[N/A]是指该文件没有构成这种风险。 • 释放有可能被滥用或双重用途的已释放模型时,应采取必要的保障措施,允许控制地使用该模型,例如要求用户遵守使用准则或限制进入模型或实施安全过滤器。 二. 支助 从互联网上取出的数据组可能构成安全风险。 作者应说明他们如何避免释放不安全的图像。 我们认识到,提供有效保障是一项挑战,许多文件并不要求这样做,但我们鼓励作者考虑到这一点并作出最真诚的努力。 12. 现有资产的许可证问题: 纸上是否使用资产(例如代码、数据、模型)的创造者或原始所有者,是否适当记名,是否明确提到并适当遵守许可证和使用条件? 答复:[是] 说明: 本文引用了工作中使用的现有数据集、工具和编码库,包括公共基准和渲染工具,并遵循其预定的研究用途。 • 答案[N/A]是指该文件不使用现有资产。 作者应引述产生代码包或数据集的原始文件。 作者应说明使用了哪个版本的资产,并在可能的情况下包括一个URL。 许可证的名称(如CC-BY 4.0)应当包括每项资产. 二. 支助 对于某一来源(如网站)的报废数据,应当提供该来源的版权和服务条件。 资产被放行的,应当提供许可证,著作权信息,包件中的使用条件. 对于受欢迎的数据集,使用code.com/dataset的论文拥有一些数据集的许可证。 他们的许可证指南有助于确定一个数据集的许可证。 二. 支助 对于重新包装的现有数据集,应提供原始许可证和衍生资产的许可证(如果已经改变)。 如果不在网上提供这种信息,鼓励作者接触资产的创造者。 13. 新资产问题:文件中介绍的新资产是否有详细记录,与资产一起提供的文件是否充分? 答复:[是] 说明: 该文件介绍了一种由计划驱动的合成数据集/管子,并记录了其生成程序、说明和预定的研究用途。 将酌情向发行计划和文件提供补充材料或项目页。 准则: 答案[N/A]是指该文件没有释放出新的资产。 • 研究人员应通过结构化模板通报数据集/代码/模型的细节,作为其提交材料的一部分。 • 培训、许可证、限制等细节 文件应讨论是否以及如何从资产被使用的人那里获得同意。 在提交时,请记住对您的资产进行匿名(如果适用)。 您可以创建一个匿名的 URL , 或者包含一个匿名的 zip 文件 。 14. 与人类主题有关的众包和研究 关于与人类主体的众包实验和研究,论文是否包括提供给参与者的指示和(如果适用的话)截图的全文,以及(如果有)补偿的细节? blocks.en: Question: Do the main claims made in the abstract and introduction accurately reflect the paper’s contributions and scope?

blocks.en: Justification: The abstract and introduction state the main contributions of SchemaPose, including the schema-guided framework, parametric category schema, schema-driven data generation, and empirical validation. The claims are supported by the method and experimental sections.

blocks.en: Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the abstract and introduction do not include the claims made in the paper. • The abstract and/or introduction should clearly state the claims made, including the contributions made in the paper and important assumptions and limitations. A [No] or [N/A] answer to this question will not be perceived well by the reviewers. • The claims made should match theoretical and experimental results, and reflect how much the results can be expected to generalize to other settings. • It is fine to include aspirational goals as motivation as long as it is clear that these goals are not attained by the paper.

blocks.en: Question: Does the paper discuss the limitations of the work performed by the authors?
blocks.zh: 问题: 文件是否讨论了作者所做工作的限制?

blocks.en: Answer: [Yes]
blocks.zh: 答复:[是]

blocks.en: Justification: The paper discusses the scope and limitations of schema construction, including its reliance on parametric templates and its applicability to object categories whose structural variation can be reasonably captured by such templates.
blocks.zh: 说明: 该文件讨论了计划构建的范围和局限性,包括它依赖参数模板及其适用于其结构变化能够被这种模板合理反映的对象类别。

blocks.en: Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the paper has no limitation while the answer [No] means that the paper has limitations, but those are not discussed in the paper. • The authors are encouraged to create a separate “Limitations” section in their paper. • The paper should point out any strong assumptions and how robust the results are to violations of these assumptions (e.g., independence assumptions, noiseless settings, model well-specification, asymptotic approximations only holding locally). The authors should reflect on how these assumptions might be violated in practice and what the implications would be. • The authors should reflect on the scope of the claims made, e.g., if the approach was only tested on a few datasets or with a few runs. In general, empirical results often depend on implicit assumptions, which should be articulated. • The authors should reflect on the factors that influence the performance of the approach. For example, a facial recognition algorithm may perform poorly when image resolution is low or images are taken in low lighting. Or a speech-to-text system might not be used reliably to provide closed captions for online lectures because it fails to handle technical jargon. • The authors should discuss the computational efficiency of the proposed algorithms and how they scale with dataset size. • If applicable, the authors should discuss possible limitations of their approach to address problems of privacy and fairness. • While the authors might fear that complete honesty about limitations might be used by reviewers as grounds for rejection, a worse outcome might be that reviewers discover limitations that aren’t acknowledged in the paper. The authors should use their best judgment and recognize that individual actions in favor of transparency play an important role in developing norms that preserve the integrity of the community. Reviewers will be specifically instructed to not penalize honesty concerning limitations.

blocks.en: Question: For each theoretical result, does the paper provide the full set of assumptions and a complete (and correct) proof?

blocks.en: Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not include theoretical results. • All the theorems, formulas, and proofs in the paper should be numbered and cross-referenced. • All assumptions should be clearly stated or referenced in the statement of any theorems. • The proofs can either appear in the main paper or the supplemental material, but if they appear in the supplemental material, the authors are encouraged to provide a short proof sketch to provide intuition. • Inversely, any informal proof provided in the core of the paper should be complemented by formal proofs provided in appendix or supplemental material. • Theorems and Lemmas that the proof relies upon should be properly referenced.
